l2: 一元微分学（求导与作图）
question:
设 $a_{1},a_{2},\cdots,a_{n}$ 为常数，且

\left| \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} a _ {k} \sin k x \right| \leqslant | \sin x |, \quad \left| \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} a _ {n - j + 1} \sin j x \right| \leqslant | \sin x |.

证明 $\left|\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k\right| \leqslant \frac{2}{n+1}$ .

steps.text: 分析 设 $f(x) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k \sin kx$ , $g(x) = \sum_{j=1}^{n} a_{n-j+1} \sin jx$ ，易知 $f'(0) + g'(0) = (n+1) \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k$ ，从而只需证明 $|f'(0)| \leqslant 1, |g'(0)| \leqslant 1$ .
设 $f(x) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k \sin kx, g(x) = \sum_{j=1}^{n} a_{n-j+1} \sin jx$ ，则

\begin{array}{c} f ^ {\prime} (x) = a _ {1} \cos x + 2 a _ {2} \cos 2 x + \dots + n a _ {n} \cos n x, \\ g ^ {\prime} (x) = a _ {n} \cos x + 2 a _ {n - 1} \cos 2 x + \dots + n a _ {1} \cos n x, \\ f ^ {\prime} (0) + g ^ {\prime} (0) = (n + 1) (a _ {1} + a _ {2} + \dots + a _ {n}). \end{array}
